extracted.name: Blistered Shishito Peppers
extracted.description: Blistered Shishito Peppers are mild and slightly sweet, charred in a skillet and the best appetizer you can have ready in just 10 minutes.
ingredient_lines: Sea salt or flake salt (, for garnish)
instruction_lines: Heat a large cast iron skillet over medium high heat. Once hot, add oil. Once hot, add peppers, spreading them out in an even layer.
Cook undisturbed for 45 seconds or so, until browned on bottom. Turn them and continue cooking, turning them every so often, until blistered on all sides. Should take about 4-5 minutes.
A few seconds before removing them from heat, add ginger to the pan and sauté. Drizzle peppers with soy sauce and honey and toss to combine.
Remove to a plate and garnish with salt and sesame seeds.
categories: What to do with shishito peppers
